title: Sakina AI - AI Wellness Companion
description: A microservices-based mobile wellness application integrating an autonomous 6-container Docker architecture and a locally fine-tuned language model.
longDescription: Sakina AI was developed as a comprehensive mobile wellness companion that provides AI-driven conversational support, mood journaling, and timezone-aware push notifications. Transitioning from an initial architectural blueprint to a live system, the backend was orchestrated into four core microservices (Chat, Auth, AI Wrapper, and Notification) passing through a high-throughput YARP API Gateway. To ensure strict user privacy and eliminate recurring cloud costs, a lightweight open-source LLM was fine-tuned locally using QLoRA with 4-bit NF4 quantization, maintaining target inference latencies under three seconds. On the data layer, a Redis Cache-Aside pattern was integrated with the PostgreSQL instances to achieve an approximate 87% average reduction in session-retrieval latency under multi-user concurrent loads.
contributions: Engineered the microservices backend using C# ASP.NET Core 9.0 and deployed a 6-container Docker architecture via a YARP API Gateway.
Optimized session retrieval performance by implementing a Redis Cache-Aside pattern, dropping median latency from 185ms to 18ms (an 87% reduction).
Configured and integrated a locally deployed QLoRA fine-tuned LLM using 4-bit quantization to handle empathetic, wellness-aligned user chat queries with sub-3-second inference.
Developed a cross-platform mobile frontend utilizing React Native (Expo SDK 54) with secure device token storage and Expo Push API timezone-aware notification handling.

title: Financial Portfolio Management Web App
description: A microservices-based financial platform engineered to securely execute and visualize TFSA and cryptocurrency transactions.
longDescription: This project is a modular, microservices-based financial web application designed to execute and manage real-time Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA) and cryptocurrency asset transactions. The platform utilizes a robust Java and Apache Tomcat backend infrastructure integrated with a MySQL database layout. To ensure secure user entry and horizontal scalability, independent RESTful APIs were engineered for stock trading, crypto account management, and user registration, all tied together using cross-service JSON Web Token (JWT) session management. On the frontend, a highly interactive interface was constructed using vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to deliver responsive financial performance tracking and real-time market trend charting, culminating in a 25% optimization in database processing efficiency.
contributions: Engineered the platform's microservices architecture using Java, Apache Tomcat, and MySQL to seamlessly handle high-throughput asset transactions.
Designed and developed independent, modular RESTful APIs for automated stock trading, crypto accounts, and user registration workflows.
Implemented secure stateless user authentication and cross-service session validation by integrating JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
Built a dynamic frontend interface to render interactive charts visualizing real-time market trends, improving database processing efficiency by 25%.
